    *   *Combined:* It creates a machine-readable metadata layer that sits *under* the natural language of the code, ensuring tooling can extract actionable items (e.g., `[HACK]` triggers a warning, `[OPT]` triggers a performance audit) without parsing unstructured text.

Lowercase ensures consistent hashing and regex matching across all code modules, while square brackets act as explicit delimiters for static analysis tools. This structure allows our CI pipeline to automatically detect tags like `[SEC]` or `[PERF]` and trigger specific scans or alerts, turning comments into executable directives rather than static documentation that decays over time.
